lines.t: In the quiet of the evening, I whisper all my prayers to you
Of all the things I thank you for And of how much I love you
I long for when you take me, get me up to you
I have been waiting, I know your promise is true
I'm watching at the window, listening for the sound of you calling me
Oh my bridegroom, come quickly along for the day
When you come and take me, my heart yearns to be with you
I feel my love so strong, my love so true
That I've had for you
For so long
Come take me
Through the waiting and the longing, through the joy and tears
You've been my steady promise through the passing years
Oh, I cannot see you, still are you nearby You are gazing down on me from high
My bride, bridegroom, my first love I can't wait until you take me, take me up above
Oh my bridegroom, come quickly
I long for the day when you come and take me
My heart yearns to be with you
I feel a love so strong, a love so true
That I've had you for so long
Oh my bridegroom, come take me
You are the holy promised one
Every tear will fade away
When you call my name that day
I will run into your world
Safe within your love
Oh my cry girl, I'm too deep for you
To give up when you come and take me
My love so strong, so deep
I feel love so strong, my love so true
Know that I'm better than you
For you for so long
I cry for you
Come take me
